mapper.sql: vgroups.id AS id, vgroups.name AS name, vgroups.vendor_type_id AS typeId, vendor_types.name AS typeName, vgroups.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, vgroups.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM vgroups LEFT JOIN vendor_types ON vendor_types.id = vgroups.vendor_type_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = vgroups.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = vgroups.modified_by

WHERE vgroups.is_active = 1
AND vgroups.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR vendor_types.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vgroups ( name, vendor_type_id, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{vendorGroup.name}, #{vendorGroup.typeId}, NOW(), #{vendorGroup.createdBy}, #{vendorGroup.isActive} )
mapper.select: SELECT companies.id AS id, companies.name AS name FROM vgroup_companies LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = vgroup_companies.company_id WHERE companies.is_active = 1 AND vgroup_companies.vgroup_id = #{vGroupId}

SELECT vendor_vgroups.vendor_id AS id, vendors.name AS name FROM vendor_vgroups LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = vendor_vgroups.vendor_id WHERE vendors.is_active = 1 AND vendor_vgroups.vgroup_id = #{vGroupId}
